prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
Rust forbids a `#[repr(packed)]` type from containing a `#[repr(align(...))]` type, including transitively through nested structs or unions. This produces error **E0588**.

```rust
#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(i32);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Aligned); // error
```

The restriction also applies when the aligned type is nested inside another type:

```rust
struct Wrapper(Aligned);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Wrapper); // error
```

A type cannot use both `packed` and `align` itself; that produces **E0587**:

```rust
#[repr(packed, align(8))]
struct Invalid(i32); // error
```

The reverse nesting is allowed: a `#[repr(align(...))]` type may contain a `#[repr(packed)]` type.

Sources: [E0588](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/error_codes/E0588.html), [E0587](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/error_codes/E0587.html).
